changes.before: Faithfulness asks whether distinct semantic arrows can become indistinguishable. Fullness asks whether every compatible comparison comes from a semantic one. Essential surjectivity asks whether every intended coherent datum is realized by an actual semantic object.
changes.after: Faithfulness asks whether distinct semantic arrows with the same source and target can become indistinguishable. Fullness asks whether every arrow between the images of two semantic objects comes from an arrow between those objects. Essential surjectivity asks whether every object of \(\mathcal K\) is isomorphic to the image of an actual semantic object.
changes.justification: Clarify the three functor properties already named, including the parallel-arrow scope and the isomorphism in essential surjectivity. No theorem changes.
